criteria.effectiveness: Real runner assertion/exit for the selected population; collection alone is not sensitivity proof.
criteria.theatre: Useful witness only when invoked with stated config/tools; empty/conditional selections remain explicit.
criteria.tautology: Member oracles, not script presence, carry truth; shared family limits apply only to reached members.
criteria.duplication: Same names at different cwd, tool, event or timing are not automatically redundant.
criteria.costEffectiveness: Retain useful witnesses; measure this command/setup before optimizing. Aggregate CI timestamps are not this invocation duration.
criteria.sufficiency: Protects the selected population only; no claim that every assertion discriminates every fault.

criteria.relevance: Reject TypeScript diagnostic/type-contract violations in the configured program.
criteria.effectiveness: tsc --noEmit loads this cwd tsconfig; nonzero diagnostics fail.
criteria.theatre: Static typecheck is useful but provides no runtime test execution.
criteria.tautology: Compiler judgment is independent of expected test output; permissive declarations/skipLibCheck limit strength.
criteria.duplication: Typecheck and runtime tests expose different fault classes; no substitute or no-loss deletion shown.
criteria.costEffectiveness: Keep bounded compiler check; cost unallocated. Workspace recursion may compile shared imports repeatedly, but no measured removable duplication established.
criteria.sufficiency: Only the tsconfig include/exclude program and compiler policy; excluded templates/vendor/install are not covered.

criteria.relevance: Detect divergence between canonical source and derived artifacts/policy.
criteria.effectiveness: Check mode computes or inspects actual source and returns mismatch diagnostics/nonzero; exact command fixes surface.
criteria.theatre: Byte/schema consistency is useful, not proof generated material behaves correctly.
criteria.tautology: Expected source/generated relationship is declared separately; shared generator bugs require independent behavior witnesses.
criteria.duplication: Write and check have distinct roles; local and CI timing are retained.
criteria.costEffectiveness: Keep deterministic comparison at its needed boundary; no standalone timing measured. Do not infer canonical Node-chain cost.
criteria.sufficiency: Bounded declared source/output closure; semantic correctness requires the owning test/consumer witnesses.

criteria.relevance: Produce or install the command-specific artifact.
criteria.effectiveness: Successful generation/install exit and resulting bytes are operational observations; this invocation is not an adverse test.
criteria.theatre: Do not count producer success as a quality verdict.
criteria.tautology: No independent expected outcome here; check-mode/tests must supply it.
criteria.duplication: Producer and drift checker are not duplicate tests; package aliases may serve different callers.
criteria.costEffectiveness: Run when artifact is needed; retain supported entrypoint, no recurring test-cost saving inferred.
criteria.sufficiency: Output existence alone cannot establish behavior or installed delivery correctness.

criteria.effectiveness: Actual named scanner diagnostics and exit, under its declared scope/tool conditions.
criteria.theatre: Finite static checking is useful; clean output is not general semantic certification.
criteria.tautology: Checker policy is separate from checked input; its tests/fault controls establish sensitivity separately.
criteria.duplication: Different policy, range, host or timing remains distinct protection.
criteria.costEffectiveness: Keep bounded useful check; per-command maintenance and execution unmeasured, no cheapness assertion.
criteria.sufficiency: Only the named rule/input surface; advisory and missing-tool states are not passes.

criteria.relevance: Expose a local coverage/capability limit to the operator.
criteria.effectiveness: Emits warning; no validator runs in this row.
criteria.theatre: Observation only: do not count as passing quality gate.
criteria.tautology: No semantic oracle; warning is an honest unverified state.
criteria.duplication: Not equivalent to the CI check it names.
criteria.costEffectiveness: Negligible command body but no measured duration; retain explicit local limit.
criteria.sufficiency: Relies on separately invoked CI/owner action, cannot block bad input.

criteria.relevance: Deliver the exact configured command at the named native event/matcher.
criteria.effectiveness: Harness runs command and interprets its exit/output; registration bytes alone do not prove firing.
criteria.theatre: Registration is delivery wiring, not another test or proof host obeyed it.
criteria.tautology: Owned command/test oracles remain separate from configuration presence.
criteria.duplication: Canonical/plugin/contributor registrations target different install/harness homes; do not deduplicate from matching names.
criteria.costEffectiveness: Cost repeats at the declared event and timeout; actual native frequency/duration unmeasured.
criteria.sufficiency: Only this event/matcher/command; native firing requires supported-host evidence, absent in S1.

criteria.relevance: Dispatch declared Git lifecycle checks/producers for this entrypoint.
criteria.effectiveness: Hook executes command chain under staged/range/tool conditions; exit propagation determines blocking.
criteria.theatre: Hook file presence is not evidence that Git invoked it or all branches ran.
criteria.tautology: Underlying checks carry separate policy/oracles; hook orchestration tests cover routing.
criteria.duplication: Earlier staged checks and later range/full checks protect different timing; fallback is reduced.
criteria.costEffectiveness: Recurring commit/push cost unallocated; optimize only with workload and retained protection evidence.
criteria.sufficiency: Actual core.hooksPath, executable hook, capability branches and declared fallback limit coverage.
